title.value: Asymmetry in the Complexity of the Multi-Commodity Network Pricing Problem
title.justification: The title was chosen as it accurately reflects the main topic discussed in the paper: the complexity of solving the network pricing problem when dealing with multiple commodities.
title.quote: Title of the paper: Asymmetry in the Complexity of the Multi-Commodity Network Pricing Problem

extractions.description: The paper investigates the complexity of the Multi-Commodity Network Pricing Problem (MC-NPP) in relation to two parameters: the number of tolled arcs and the number of commodities. It establishes that the problem can be solved in polynomial time when the number of tolled arcs is fixed, despite being NP-hard otherwise. The paper introduces a novel property called 'strong bilevel feasibility' and develops an algorithm for generating valid inequalities to solve the MC-NPP more effectively.
